sections.heading: 1. Acceptance of these Terms
paragraphs: By creating an account or using Excerpta ("the Service"), you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you don't agree, please don't use the Service.

sections.heading: 2. What Excerpta Does
paragraphs: Excerpta lets you upload documents (PDF, DOCX, CSV, and common code file formats) and ask questions about them in plain language. Answers are generated by AI and are grounded in your documents wherever possible, with citations linking back to the exact page or passage they were drawn from.
Citations are a tool to help you verify an answer, not a guarantee of accuracy. Always check the cited passage yourself before relying on an answer for anything important.

sections.heading: 3. Your Account
paragraphs: You can create an account with an email and password, or by signing in with Google or GitHub. You're responsible for keeping your credentials secure and for all activity under your account.
You must be old enough to legally agree to these Terms in your country of residence.

sections.heading: 4. Your Content
paragraphs: You keep ownership of the documents you upload. By uploading a document, you give Excerpta permission to store it, extract its text, generate embeddings from it, and process it through AI models solely to provide the Service to you.
Don't upload anything you don't have the right to upload, or content that's illegal, infringing, or harmful to others.

sections.heading: 5. Plans and Billing
paragraphs: Excerpta offers a Free plan and paid Pro and Team plans, each with a monthly document upload limit that resets at the start of each calendar month. Paid plans are billed through Stripe.
You can upgrade, downgrade, or cancel a paid plan at any time from Settings → Billing, which opens Stripe's billing portal. Charges already processed are not refunded except where required by law.

sections.heading: 6. Acceptable Use
paragraphs: Don't use Excerpta to try to break the Service, access another user's data, upload malware, or automate abusive volumes of requests.

sections.heading: 7. Ending Your Account
paragraphs: You can delete your account at any time from Settings → Account. This permanently removes your documents, conversations, and account data — see our Privacy Policy for exactly what that involves. We may also suspend or terminate accounts that violate these Terms.

sections.heading: 8. Disclaimers
paragraphs: The Service is provided "as is." AI-generated answers can be incomplete or wrong even when a citation is shown. Excerpta isn't liable for decisions made based on the Service's output.

sections.heading: 9. Changes to These Terms
paragraphs: We may update these Terms as the Service evolves. If we make a material change, we'll update the date at the top of this page.

sections.heading: 10. Contact
paragraphs: Questions about these Terms? Reach us at legal@excerpta.app.

sections.heading: 1. Overview
paragraphs: This Privacy Policy explains what information Excerpta collects, why, and how it's handled. Using the Service means you're okay with what's described here.

sections.heading: 2. Information We Collect
paragraphs: Account information: your name, email address, and profile details from Google or GitHub if you sign in that way.
Your documents: the files you upload, the text extracted from them, and the embeddings generated from that text so the Service can find relevant passages when you ask a question.
Conversations: the questions you ask and the answers and citations generated in response.
Billing information: your subscription plan and usage, handled through Stripe — Excerpta never sees or stores your card details directly.
A small amount of technical data (like your chosen language) stored in cookies, covered below.

sections.heading: 3. How We Use It
paragraphs: To run the Service: process your documents, answer your questions, and keep your account and subscription working.
To enforce plan limits and prevent abuse.
We don't sell your data, and we don't use your documents to train AI models.

sections.heading: 4. Where Things Are Stored and Processed
paragraphs: Uploaded files are stored on Vercel Blob. Extracted text is converted into embeddings and stored in a vector database (Upstash) so relevant passages can be retrieved when you ask a question. Questions and document excerpts are sent to third-party AI providers (Google Gemini, Groq) to generate an answer — only what's needed to answer that question, not your whole document library at once.

sections.heading: 5. Cookies
paragraphs: Excerpta uses a session cookie to keep you signed in and a small cookie to remember your language preference (English or French). We don't use third-party advertising or tracking cookies.

sections.heading: 6. Who We Share Data With
paragraphs: Only the service providers that make Excerpta work: Stripe for billing, Vercel for hosting and file storage, Upstash for the vector database, and the AI providers used to generate answers. None of them can use your data for anything other than providing that service to Excerpta.

sections.heading: 7. Keeping and Deleting Your Data
paragraphs: Your documents and conversations stay stored for as long as your account exists. Deleting your account — from Settings → Account — permanently removes your uploaded files, their extracted text and embeddings, your conversations, and your account record. This can't be undone.

sections.heading: 8. Your Rights
paragraphs: You can review, update, or delete your data at any time from Settings, without needing to contact us. If you'd rather reach out directly, email privacy@excerpta.app.

sections.heading: 9. Security
paragraphs: Data is encrypted in transit and access to it is limited to what's needed to run the Service. No system is perfectly secure, but we take reasonable steps to protect your information.

sections.heading: 10. Children
paragraphs: Excerpta isn't directed at children, and we don't knowingly collect data from anyone under the age required to legally hold an account in their country.

sections.heading: 11. Changes to This Policy
paragraphs: If we make a material change to how we handle your data, we'll update the date at the top of this page.

sections.heading: 12. Contact
paragraphs: Questions about this policy? Reach us at privacy@excerpta.app.
